nodes.description: State variable holding the staking period duration in seconds.
State variable tracking the total amount of tokens staked across all users.
ERC20 token contract used as the staking token.
ERC20 token contract used as the reward token.
Private total supply constant used for reward math.
Private total rewards pool used to compute rewards per day.
Mapping of address to Staker struct recording stake, start time, earned and period.
Owner address inherited from Ownable, used for access control.
External stake function that registers or updates a staker and pulls tokens via transferFrom.
External claim function that transfers accrued rewards then resets staker accounting.
External unstake function that transfers principal plus rewards then deletes the staker.
Owner-only function to extend the global stake duration.
Owner-only function to transfer the full balance of an arbitrary token out of the contract.
Public view returning the total earned rewards for a staker.
Private view computing rewards earned based on block.timestamp and stake share.
Public view returning whether an address is currently staking.
Public view returning the staked amount of a user.
Fallback receive function accepting plain Ether transfers.
Private view computing the staker's proportional share of totalStaked.
Private view computing rewards per day from the total rewards pool.
Private view converting the staker period into days.
Caller-controlled address used for staking identity and transfers.
Miner/validator influenced timestamp used for reward accrual and stake start.
External call stakingToken.transferFrom pulling funds into the contract in stake().
External call stakingToken.transfer paying rewards before state reset in claim().
External call stakingToken.transfer paying principal plus rewards before delete in unstake().
External call token.transfer draining an arbitrary token balance in emergencyWithdrawToken().
Parameter of stake() giving the amount of tokens to stake.
Parameter of extrendStakeDuration() giving the new duration value.
Parameter of emergencyWithdrawToken() giving the arbitrary ERC20 to drain.
Parameter of userEarnedTotal() giving the staker address to query.
Local variable holding the computed reward in claim().
Local variable holding the computed reward in unstake().
Local variable holding the computed earned amount in _userEarned().

edges.reason: msg.sender determines the staker identity and the transferFrom source in stake().
msg.sender controls whose rewards are claimed in claim().
msg.sender controls whose stake is withdrawn in unstake().
block.timestamp sets the staker start time, a timestamp dependency.
block.timestamp resets the accrual start after claim, a timestamp dependency.
block.timestamp indirectly influences rewards paid during unstake.
_userEarned uses block.timestamp to compute seconds staked, a timestamp dependency.
stake() invokes the external stakingToken.transferFrom call.
claim() invokes the external stakingToken.transfer call.
unstake() invokes the external stakingToken.transfer call.
emergencyWithdrawToken() invokes the external token.transfer call.
A malicious token could re-enter claim() before the staker start and earned fields are reset.
A malicious token could re-enter unstake() before the staker entry is deleted and totalStaked updated.
stake() writes the _stakers mapping entries.
claim() resets start and earned fields in the _stakers mapping.
unstake() deletes the caller entry from the _stakers mapping.
stake() increments totalStaked.
unstake() decrements totalStaked.
stake() sets the staker period from stakeDuration.
extrendStakeDuration() updates the stakeDuration state variable.
onlyOwner modifier checks _owner against msg.sender for extrendStakeDuration().
onlyOwner modifier checks _owner against msg.sender for emergencyWithdrawToken().
claim() calls userEarnedTotal() to compute the payout.
unstake() calls userEarnedTotal() to compute the payout.
userEarnedTotal() calls _userEarned() for the currently earned amount.
userEarnedTotal() reads the previously earned value from the _stakers mapping.
_userEarned() calls _sharePercentage() for the staker share.
_userEarned() reads start, staked and period from the _stakers mapping.
_sharePercentage() reads the staker staked amount from _stakers.
_sharePercentage() divides by totalStaked which can be zero or manipulated, risking division-by-zero and precision issues.
_rewardsPerDay() divides _totalRewards by the period, risking division by zero or overflow in scaling.
_rewardsPerDay() calls _periodInDays() to obtain the period.
_periodInDays() reads the staker period from the _stakers mapping.
isStaking() reads the _stakers mapping to check registration.
userStaked() reads the staked field from the _stakers mapping.
stake() uses the stakeAmount parameter when updating staked balances.
extrendStakeDuration() uses the duration parameter to set the new stake duration.
emergencyWithdrawToken() uses the token parameter as the transfer target contract.
userEarnedTotal() uses the staker parameter to look up the staker entry.
The local claim_reward value is passed into the external transfer in claim().
The local unstake_reward value is passed into the external transfer in unstake().
The local earned value is computed inside and returned by _userEarned().
The stakingToken state variable is the target contract of the external transferFrom call.
The stakingToken state variable is the target contract of the external transfer in claim().
The stakingToken state variable is the target contract of the external transfer in unstake().

normalization_plan.reason: The stakeAmount parameter only flows into stake() accounting and has no independent identity.
The duration parameter is local to the owner-only duration update and should be folded into the function.
The token parameter is only used to select the transfer target inside emergencyWithdrawToken().
The staker parameter is only a lookup key inside userEarnedTotal().
The claim_reward local variable is the amount passed directly into the unsafe external transfer in claim().
The unstake_reward local variable is the amount passed directly into the unsafe external transfer in unstake().
The earned local variable is computed and returned entirely within _userEarned().
